description: TVS Supply Chain Solutions reported a 28.7% rise in Q1FY27 revenue and 34% growth in adjusted EBITDA, supported by strong volumes and global forwarding. Record quarterly business wins reached ₹543 crore, while adjusted PBT surged 71%.

title: DBS Bank extends Rs 520-cr credit to K Raheja Corp to develop commercial tower in Pune
description: DBS Bank India has announced a substantial investment of Rs 520 crore for the development of a commercial tower in Pune. Additionally, Certus Capital has pledged over Rs 1,000 crore to various real estate projects in the first half of 2026, covering key cities such as Hyderabad, Mumbai, Chennai, and the National Capital Region.

title: Tribeca, Ira Realty to build Trump-branded housing project in Hyderabad at Rs 2,000 cr investment
description: Tribeca Developers and Ira Realty are thrilled to announce their ambitious Trump-branded luxury housing project nestled in Hyderabad. The venture, requiring a hefty investment of Rs 2,000 crore, will boast two magnificent 65-storey structures featuring a total of 450 high-end apartments. With construction kicking off, the project is on track for completion in four years. This signifies the debut of a Trump-branded initiative in the vibrant South Indian market.

title: State Bank of India returns to dollar debt market, bankers see strong demand
description: State Bank of India is set to re-enter the dollar bond market, marking its first appearance in nearly a year. The nation's leading financial institution foresees strong investor interest in its five-year bond offer. This decision comes in the wake of the Reserve Bank of India's launch of a swap facility earlier this June. SBI targets a minimum fundraising of $500 million, with current promotional activities underway.

title: Indian bonds slip as crude hovers near $90
description: Indian government bonds declined on Tuesday as oil prices briefly surged past ninety dollars. Traders awaited inflation data for clues on the Reserve Bank of India's interest rate path. Elevated oil prices could potentially fuel inflation and strain India's fiscal balance. Ample banking system liquidity supported demand, especially for short-term debt instruments. Foreign investors also purchased longer-dated bonds as the yield curve steepened.

title: RVNL Q1 Results: Net profit rises 18% YoY, EBITDA more than doubles
description: Rail Vikas Nigam reported an 18.5% year-on-year rise in Q1FY27 net profit to ₹159.36 crore, while revenue increased 10.6%. EBITDA more than doubled, lifting margins, though profit and revenue declined sequentially amid continued pressure on the stock.

title: Retail traders lost $9.6 billion in equity derivatives
description: The Indian equity market saw investors experiencing a striking loss of 916.85 billion rupees in futures and options trading. Retail trader involvement in equity derivatives has significantly dwindled from the previous year. This downturn signifies the impact of regulatory reforms aimed at reducing reckless speculative behavior. With the Securities and Exchange Board of India and policymakers introducing multiple safeguards, there has been a noticeable impact on overall trading volumes.
